value: Production builds constraints from axis names and pole labels only; this arm adds the map rationale the app currently drops.
Scales differ (production is continuous -1..+1, the judge is 1-5), so this reports rank correlation and side agreement rather than point differences.
Grounded judging supplies the map rationale as the axis definition; blind judging supplies only the axis name and pole labels. All headline metrics elsewhere in this benchmark use grounded judging.
